title: Test 4 — Move a cell, track trajectory and shape
agent_prompt: Stimulate one side of all cells dynamically with optogenetics to cause the cells to induce directed migration. The channel phase-contrast is used for imaging, and the channel stimulation is used to stimulate the cells. Apply the stimulation every 30 seconds for 5 minutes, also capture an image showing the membrane channel at each timepoint. Record the trajectory of the moving cell from its centre and also segment the cell’s shape after each image is captured. Save the images in two separate folders, one for the stimulation images and one for the segmentation images; save the trajectory in a CSV file with the following format: cell_id, stimulation_time, x-position, y-position. Add the images and the trajectory to the Napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: CSV file with the trajectories at each stimulation
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
